description_en: Queries the count of protectable nodes that can be added to a hybrid cloud cluster
description_zh: 获取混合云集群可添加的防护数
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-protectable-count --instance-id waf-cn-4xl3fdi4u0100fe23 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudProtectableCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值范围如下：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

ProtectableCount.description_en: The number of protectable nodes that can be added to the cluster
ProtectableCount.description_zh: 集群可添加的防护节点数
